body:
Compiled EMILY/docs/MONOREPO_PRODUCT_AUDIT_2026-09-12.md per founder real-time direction: every real repo scored on product/first-60-seconds-zero-install/install-friction/what's-broken, ranked with the founder's own explicit rule that no-download beats fast-but-download. Headline finding: MJOLNIR is completely uninstallable (13/13 CI runs failed, no APK exists). Only GoblinFoxDragon (telnet/ssh) and OKEMILY/IDUNA (browser) are real Tier-1 zero-install candidates today. REDGARDEN exists as 3 drifting copies (REDGARDEN/redgarden-deploy/redgarden-stable) with no canonical link named.

⚓ ☃
title: Full monorepo product audit — 56 repos
